functions.name: Duration.Days
functions.signature: Duration.Days(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number
functions.summary: Returns the days portion of a duration.

functions.name: Duration.From
functions.signature: Duration.From(value as any) as nullable duration
functions.summary: Creates a duration from the given value.

functions.name: Duration.FromText
functions.signature: Duration.FromText(text as nullable text) as nullable duration

functions.summary: Returns the minutes portion of a duration.

functions.name: Duration.Seconds

functions.name: Duration.ToRecord
functions.summary: Returns a record containing the parts of the duration.

functions.name: Duration.TotalDays
functions.signature: Duration.TotalDays(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number

functions.name: Duration.TotalHours
functions.signature: Duration.TotalHours(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number

functions.name: Duration.TotalMinutes
functions.signature: Duration.TotalMinutes(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number
